column1: # Documents generated and then withdrawn from this arm. Kept because deleting
# the record of a measurement that once existed is exactly the habit this
# project argues against. These were generated against a model ALIAS, then
# regenerated against the resolved and pinned id, and the files were removed
# while these rows were not. Recorded 2026-09-01. They are not measured: only
# .txt files on disk are, and none of these are on disk.
